seed: Objects of type `reflection` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [player] show mixed outcomes: h,pixels,w,y x1, gone x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: state accumulated across earlier steps that the frame does not show. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Two axes (row band R, column band C) on 21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks; A5 cycles C->R->pieces(by min block col,row)->C; A1/A2 move C or selected piece by -/+1 block col, A3/A4 move R or piece by -/+1 block row (axes bounded only; pieces bounded and blocked by other pieces).
Visible gray reflections = piece blocks mirrored across R (skip piece blocks); across C and across both = invisible occluders that only count in reflection ranking.
Frame re-rendered from per-block layered sprite stacks (piece>refl>invisible>target>walls; centre = first solid else topmost fill) then re-extracted: wall/player = 4-conn comps of own cells + all 0 cells ranked by bbox (x,y); targets merged while bbox gap <=3.
The reflection gone/changed outcome under A1 is re-rendering and re-ranking of derived reflections, not hidden accumulated state; passes 45/45 stateless too.
Unconfirmed: A5 cycle order with more than 2 pieces; intersection-only 0 selection ambiguity resolved via hidden state, default C.
